title: 1.5" / C Size Aluminum Double Ball Mount with Extension(18.3") Arm and Two AMPS Round Plates
description:
Sturdy and Reliable —— This marine electronic mount made of extra-long arms is a valuable alternative to multiple ball/clamp connectors joined in line. Constructed of powder-coated marine-grade aluminum, corrosion-resistant composite materials to ensure strength while reducing the increased leverage of longer arms. Less torque ensures stable installation and zero deformation over prolonged use.
Extreme Environment Durability ——The mount has been Salt Spray Tested for thousands of hours (including stainless steel bolts and springs) to resist high salt water corrosion. A specialized salt-resistant coating protects against seawater corrosion, humidity, salt spray, and industrial pollutants, making it ideal for high-salt environments like ships, coastlines, and chemical plants. Extends lifespan by over 50%.
360° Omnidirectional Adjustment ——The ball and socket technology allows for near-infinite adjustability. Instantly lock sonars, industrial computers, or sensors at optimal angles to maximize operational efficiency.
Multi-Scenario Compatibility ——Modular design supports mainstream fish finders and industrial devices. The AMPS hole pattern is designed to install directly in a boat, kayak or on any flat surface (Complimentary 4 sets of 316 marine grade stainless steel machine screws, lock nuts and sheet metal screws).
Universal Design - Includes a C size 18.3" length double socket arm and two 2.4" diameter AMPS hole pattern round base. Perfectly compatible with 1.5 inches / C size / 38 mm adapters and arms from manufacturers such as RAM Mounts, Arkon, iBolt and others.
